item.text:
**Verdict**
Partial and uneven. In 2024, Xi’s stated goals of stability, growth, and jobs were reflected in some near-term outcomes, but the stronger tests were mixed to negative: property stayed weak, medium-term fundamentals remained fragile, and the strategic/nuclear posture moved away from the restraint language Beijing used.

**Accepted Claims**

| Stance | Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Supportive | H1 2024 macro performance stayed broadly stable | National Bureau of Statistics of China | 2024-07-15 | https://www.stats.gov.cn/english/PressRelease/202407/t20240715_1955620.html | GDP grew 5.0%, employment and prices were generally stable, and incomes kept rising. Allowing for inherited weakness, this is a real short-run move in the direction Xi claimed to want. | 8B.7 |
| Supportive | Work-relief programs created jobs for low-income workers | Xinhua / english.www.gov.cn | 2024-11-04 | https://english.www.gov.cn/archive/statistics/202411/04/content_WS672879d6c6d0868f4e8ec91e.html | Local work-relief programs created 2.45 million jobs and paid 31 billion yuan in wages. That is concrete labor-market delivery, not just rhetoric. | 8B.7 |
| Mixed positive | IMF saw resilience, but not a clean success story | IMF | 2024-05-28 | https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/05/28/pr24184-china-imf-staff-completes-2024-art-iv-mission | The IMF described China’s economy as resilient, but warned that property weakness and downside risks remained. This supports partial movement in the claimed direction, not durable success. | 8B.7 |
| Negative | Real-estate investment fell sharply in H1 | National Bureau of Statistics of China | 2024-07-15 | https://www.stats.gov.cn/english/PressRelease/202407/t20240715_1955620.html | The same official data show real-estate development investment down 10.1%, which undercuts the claim that Xi’s stabilization agenda had broadly improved the outcome Xi wanted most to fix. | 8B.7 |
| Negative | Property support was too small to fix the sector | Reuters | 2024-06-09 | https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/chinas-home-destocking-push-to-bring-developers-little-cheer-3476774 | Reuters said the destocking scheme was too small to help cash-strapped developers much. This is strong evidence of only partial transmission from policy to outcome. | 8B.7 |
| Negative | IMF still saw weak medium-term fundamentals | IMF | 2024-08-02 | https://www.imf.org/en/publications/cr/issues/2024/08/01/peoples-republic-of-china-2024-article-iv-consultation-press-release-staff-report-and-552803 | The IMF said weak productivity, aging, debt, and property/local-government risks still dragged on the outlook and that a comprehensive reform package was needed. That is negative on durable outcome performance. | 8B.7 |
| Negative | China’s warhead buildup continued despite restraint rhetoric | SIPRI | 2024-06-17 | https://www.sipri.org/media/press-release/2024/role-nuclear-weapons-grows-geopolitical-relations-deteriorate-new-sipri-yearbook-out-now | SIPRI said China’s arsenal rose from 410 to 500 warheads and that some warheads may be deployed on missiles in peacetime. That moves in the opposite direction from Xi’s no-first-use / minimum-capability messaging. | 8B.7 |
| Negative | Taiwan drills worsened the regional security environment | Reuters | 2024-05-22 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/china-launches-war-games-around-taiwan-3453328 | Reuters reported “punishment” drills around Taiwan with mock attacks and heavy messaging. That is a negative outcome for Xi’s claimed preference for peaceful coexistence. | 8B.7 |
| Negative | Rocket Force purges signaled internal instability | South China Morning Post / Reuters | 2024-07-18 | https://www.scmp.com/news/china/military/article/3270993/chinas-communist-party-targets-another-pla-general-corruption-investigation?UUID=f0bc4b91-7818-4f96-bf67-aa5b46ac9395&next_article_id=3270939&tc=7&tpcc=enlz-globalimpact | Reuters reported another senior Rocket Force officer expelled amid a wider purge. That suggests brittle command discipline in a force central to strategic deterrence, not a cleanly improved outcome. | 8B.7 |

**Search Gap**
- I did not find a 2024 independent, cross-sector scoreboard that directly measures all of Xi’s claimed outcomes against a common baseline.
- The strongest positive evidence is mostly official macro statistics and targeted welfare delivery.
- The strongest negative evidence is more independent on property, medium-term growth risks, and especially strategic/nuclear outcomes.

**Bottom Line**
- Short-run macro and welfare outcomes: mostly in the claimed direction, but only partially.
- Structural economic outcomes: mixed to negative.
- Security and restraint outcomes: negative.
